body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: b6f0fac962a42cf26dce2cab7555c21d1826cf6e -->
Needs changes before merge.

The caption now reads `font_caption` and clamps invalid values. The tests check the font size, clamp limits, row spacing, and contrast.

Local results after a clean trial merge with `upstream/main` at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239`:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=6`: 855 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. All eight `ribbon_rows` tests passed.
- Integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 2 passed; `tap_hand` 3 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed; `waterjet_tool` 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:167` (evidence in the PR body): Add before and after screenshots of the changed UI. The body currently has no screenshots. Show both shipped themes so the caption size and ribbon spacing can be checked. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link the images from the PR body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

Notes:

- This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or CAM geometry. No goldens moved.
- I did not repeat the author's mutation checks. This is a UI review, outside the safety tier. The local tests above used unchanged code.
- I did not run the ignored pixel snapshot tests or open a live GUI window.
- The PR remains a draft until the requested evidence is present.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

I added before and after ribbon images for Teal Night and Horizon Day to the PR body.
The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch only.
The captures use the shipping shell layout and each shipped theme file at 1280 × 720 pixels.
The test harness supplies the viewport placeholder.
The before and after images match because both shipped themes paint 10 px captions.

The existing `ribbon_rows` tests pin the caption token, clamp limits, and row fit.
The parent-code mutation failed four tests. The code without the clamp failed the clamp test.
Each restored run passed all eight tests.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: 2af301b88c5193691b1fab737ddfdb4ce9126700.
Please review the PR again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2af301b88c5193691b1fab737ddfdb4ce9126700 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier screenshot request is complete. The PR body links before and after images for Teal Night and Horizon Day. I downloaded and checked all four images. Each pair matches, as expected: both shipped themes use 10 px captions before and after this fix. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The new evidence commit has the same source tree as the earlier reviewed head.

The caption reads `font_caption` and clamps invalid values. The tests check the token, clamp limits, caption fit, row spacing, and contrast.

Local results after a clean trial merge with `upstream/main` at `c86d6db351c863e5bbcd98dd278d667c452eb78d`:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=6`: 867 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- Integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 2 passed; `tap_hand` 3 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed; `waterjet_tool` 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The tests ran from `crates/ui`. All builds used the review worktree's own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or CAM geometry. No NC, CL, or pixel goldens changed.
- I did not repeat the author's mutation checks. This UI change is outside the safety tier. I did not change the code.
- I did not run the ignored pixel snapshot tests or open a live GUI window.
- The PR is stacked on #2027. Keep the stated merge order: merge #2027 first.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
